title: Mecha Shifty stage
summary: A one-stage April Fools version of the In The Mirror engine, played inside the Fool Metal Panic event quest.

sections.text: Play as Mecha Shifty and fight through one stage of “upgraded” Mecha Shiftys to two bosses, Mega Mecha Shifty and Mega Mekami Shifty. There are no shops, upgrades, modules or collection items here: just movement, a basic attack, a special attack and a Burst. Stages can be skipped, but a skipped stage cannot be replayed.

sections.title: Attacks
sections.note: Hit power is the projectile ATK value stored for each hit (probably a percentage of ATK; “base” = none stored). Cooldowns assume the tables’ usual 1/100 s.
rows: Raises a hand and fires an exploding shot
Five blasts that hit every enemy on screen; invincible while it plays

sections.title: Enemies
sections.note: HP is 10 (minion) or 159 (boss) base HP times the multiplier (an inference).

sections.title: Dialogue
sections.note: The cut-in conversations of the stage, in order.
items:
Mecha Shifty: You are the "upgraded" Mecha Shiftys? That is hilarious.
Mecha Shifty: I will show you. A difference in performance does not mean a difference in power!

Mecha Shifty: Mission accomplished. I am Mecha Shifty.
Mecha Shifty: ... I must stop your character merchandise business.

Mecha Shifty: Mega Mecha Shifty... Surrender, and I will forgive you this time.
Mega Mecha Shifty: Mekami Shifty gave me twice the power! Now, I am Mega Mecha Shifty x2!
Mecha Shifty: Did you say x2? Everyone, please show your support for 2x2 Love.
Mega Mecha Shifty: Privaty as a teacher and Arcana as a student! Who will the Commander choose? The student or the teacher? 2x2 Love: a true campus romance simulation!

Mecha Shifty: Situation contained.
Mecha Shifty: ... This is why robots should never get overconfident.
Mecha Shifty: Setting up a character merchandise business without me... I will not stand for it.
Mecha Shifty: ...
Mecha Shifty: Only one left now: Mekami Shifty.

Mecha Shifty: You've transformed... I didn't expect you to know such a technique. I certainly never taught it to you.
Mega Mekami Shifty: I made this body with a 3D printer. They can do amazing things these days.
Mecha Shifty: Then make one for me too, one with special coating.
Mega Mekami Shifty: No! It won't sell. The character merchandise industry revolves around cute girls!
